description: Gap analysis for all 4 live digital planners against CLAUDE.md excellence standards and competitor benchmarks.

competitor_benchmark.stickers_our_current: ~60 (3 sheets worth of content across 5 sheets)

shared_gaps.description: These gaps apply to ALL 4 planners equally.

critical.standard: Page 1 of every planner must be a Welcome page with: branded title + cover thumbnail, download instructions (3 steps), import instructions for GoodNotes/Notability, tutorial video link, customer support email
critical.impact: Top sellers with welcome pages see 30–40% fewer support messages. Currently buyers drop into the planner with zero onboarding.
critical.effort: LOW — 1 page per planner, same layout reused across all 4

critical.standard: Page 2 must be a central tappable hub linking to every section. Must have a BACK TO HOME footer link on every subsequent page.
critical.impact: Navigation dead end for buyers — they can only scroll forward. Dashboard is the #1 cited feature in top-seller reviews.
critical.effort: MEDIUM — unique layout per planner (section buttons vary), but HOME footer is a copy/paste across all pages

critical.standard: Page 3: text-based list of every section with clickable page numbers. Used for GoodNotes table of contents mode.
critical.impact: Minor UX, but competitors include it. Easy to add.

critical.standard: Minimum 5 covers at launch, target 10. Required set: Primary (current), Seasonal Spring, Seasonal Fall, Dark Mode, Minimalist, Custom Name (fillable field).
critical.impact: Covers are the #1 volume differentiator vs. top sellers. Adding covers increases listing photo options, perceived value, and justifies higher price.
critical.effort: HIGH — requires DALL-E image generation for each new cover. BLOCKED until OpenAI restored.

critical.standard: Daily Spreads × 365 are the most-requested missing feature. Layout: date header, top 3 priorities, hour-by-hour schedule (6am–10pm), notes, gratitude box, water tracker.
critical.impact: Dramatically increases page count (doubles+), justifies higher price, brings planners up to mid-tier competitor level.
critical.effort: HIGH — 365 unique dated pages per planner. Major PDF rebuild.

critical.standard: Include 2 weekly layout variations: Option A (horizontal time-blocked Mon–Sun), Option B (vertical 7-column layout). Let buyers choose via hyperlink from a 'Choose Your Layout' page.
critical.impact: Buyers cite single-layout planners as a reason to look elsewhere. Two options is a major conversion differentiator.
critical.effort: MEDIUM — duplicate weekly section with alternate layout, add chooser page

critical.gap: Sticker pack missing GoodNotes sticker book (.goodnotes) format
critical.standard: Must deliver: PNG sheets (have ✅), individual pre-cropped PNGs (missing), GoodNotes .goodnotes package (missing). ZIP structure: goodnotes_sticker_book/, png_sheets/, individual_stickers/
critical.impact: 35%+ of Etsy digital sticker buyers specifically request the .goodnotes format. Individual PNGs are requested by PDF Expert/Acrobat users.
critical.effort: MEDIUM — requires exporting individual stickers and creating .goodnotes bundle

critical.gap: No tutorial video link on Welcome page
critical.standard: Welcome page must include a link to a YouTube tutorial showing how to set up and use the planner.
critical.impact: Buyers who watch the tutorial convert at significantly higher rates and leave better reviews.
critical.effort: LOW — placeholder text until video is created: 'Watch setup tutorial → [link coming soon]'. Update once video is recorded.

critical.standard: Monthly pages should include 'Add to Calendar' buttons linking to webcal:// (Apple Calendar) or Google Calendar URLs for the month.
critical.impact: Premium feature — adds perceived value. Minor implementation.
critical.effort: LOW — add a hyperlinked button on each monthly page

critical.standard: Target: 5 sheets × 40 stickers = 200+ stickers. Current: 5 sheets exist but likely ~30–40 stickers per sheet. Need to verify all 14 functional sticker categories are covered.
critical.impact: Sticker count is prominently featured in listings ('200+ stickers'). If actual count is lower, it's a trust issue.
critical.effort: MEDIUM-HIGH — requires visual audit of all sticker sheets, then supplementing categories. BLOCKED for new generation until OpenAI restored.

critical.standard: Top sellers offer Portrait + Landscape + A4. Landscape edition would be priced at $2–4 premium over standard.
critical.impact: Significant work — full layout recreation. Long-term Phase 3 item.
critical.effort: VERY HIGH — complete layout rebuild in landscape format

niche_specific_gaps.detail: 25-min work / 5-min break timer boxes. High-demand productivity feature.
Free-write page for clearing mental clutter before planning. Common in top life planners.
Image/goal collage page. Strong emotional hook for the life planner audience.

niche_specific_gaps.gap: No Year in Pixels mood tracker
niche_specific_gaps.detail: 12-month grid, one colored box per day, color-code by mood/theme. Viral on Instagram/Pinterest — major share driver.
DP1026 Landscape Edition noted as Phase 3 product.

Time-blocking with visual chunking, Pomodoro focus sheet, Brain Dump page before each week, Priority matrix (Urgent/Important 2x2), '3 Wins Today' box on every daily page. ADHD planner niche is the fastest-growing on Etsy.
Semester class schedule grid (time slots x days of week, subject + room + professor fields).
Visual countdown to exam dates with study plan fields. High search volume for students.
Book title, author, due date, pages read, notes. Popular with English/lit students.

niche_specific_gaps.gap: Should spin off DP1030 ADHD Edition
niche_specific_gaps.detail: The ADHD feature set is large enough to be a separate product (DP1030) at a dedicated price point. The student planner should get a subset; the full ADHD suite goes in DP1030.

Visual progress bar with snowball/avalanche method support. The Dave Ramsey and debt payoff community specifically searches for this. Should show individual debts, minimum payments, extra payment, and payoff date.
Visual thermometer fill-in per savings goal. Multiple goals on one page. Hugely shareable on social media.
Monthly recurring bills checklist (bill name, due date, amount, paid checkbox). Reduces missed payments.

niche_specific_gaps.gap: No Annual Net Worth snapshot page
niche_specific_gaps.detail: Assets vs. liabilities, net worth calculation, year-over-year comparison. Appeals to the financial independence community.

niche_specific_gaps.gap: Should add Zero-Based Budget Edition as DP1028 variant
niche_specific_gaps.detail: Envelope method pages and zero-based budget sheets as a future separate product.
Before/after date headers with measurement fields (weight, chest, waist, hips, arms, legs). Space for photo reminder note. The #1 requested feature in fitness planner reviews.
Monthly tracker with 8-glass daily grid to color in. Simple but highly shareable and frequently cited in reviews.
Bedtime/wake time, hours slept, sleep quality rating, notes. Pairs naturally with the wellness angle.
Daily checkboxes per supplement. Appeals to the wellness community and those on medication routines.
Journal page for recording wins that aren't weight-related (ran first mile, slept 8 hrs, said no to junk food). Emotionally resonant — drives positive reviews.
DP1029 variant with 30 consecutive daily layouts. Separate future product.
